page.description: Information available before placing an order through this website.

operator.title: Trader and contact details
operator.body: The final order information must identify the trader responsible for confirming and fulfilling orders.

process.title: How ordering currently works
process.pending: Placing an order records the submitted products and customer details. The order remains pending confirmation by our team, which will contact the customer to confirm it.
process.noPayment: No online payment is taken by this website.
process.revalidation: Product eligibility, availability, prices, promotions, VAT, quantities and totals are checked by the server when the order is placed.

contract.title: Order confirmation and contract formation
contract.body: The exact legal effect of placing and later confirming an order must be approved before production.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.body: No delivery promise, restriction, method, charge or timing is stated until the verified commercial details below are approved.

changes.title: Cancellation, withdrawal and returns
changes.body: The applicable procedure and allocation of costs must be completed from approved commercial and legal information. No return promise is created by this development text.

complaints.title: Complaints and statutory rights
complaints.body: Approved contact and process information must be supplied before publication.
